name: web.search
description: Search the public web and return a bounded list of results (title, URL, snippet, content, score). Use for discovery and research. Does not fetch full page content. Choose a provider with the provider field; tavily is the default.

max_results.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 5; maximum 10.

search_depth.description: Search depth hint. Used by Tavily and Linkup; other providers ignore it.
